name: Documented current-account income - buy USD + one wire
who: Foreign individual with lawful Chinese salary/fees/current-account income
pros: One wire, no annual cap; bank cost modest ($53.37 on $10k; $898.75 on $400k at 11 Nov board)
cons: Needs ID + source materials incl. tax vouchers; bank may ask for more; execution rate differs from board
steps_summary: Passport -> source docs + tax evidence -> buy USD -> one own-name wire -> keep confirmations

name: Reconvert unused CNY from own FX exchange + wire
who: Foreign individual who previously exchanged FX->CNY and still holds the slip
pros: Uses own prior exchange; no new source proof beyond slip
cons: Only within 24 months; amount limited to original exchange; slip required

name: Already foreign currency - wire only
who: Anyone holding FX (not CNY) in own account
pros: No conversion, no spread; cheapest BOC-side ($32.43 on $10k; $61.31 on $400k)
cons: Still needs ID; receiving/intermediary fees may apply
steps_summary: Passport -> instruct own-name outward remittance -> pay wire fee

name: Chinese home-sale proceeds
who: Foreign individual who sold mainland housing
pros: Dedicated route; capped at price less taxes (no invented amount)
cons: Needs registered contract/title + tax voucher; bank checks cap
steps_summary: Passport -> sale/title docs + tax voucher -> bank conversion/remittance

name: Inheritance transfer
pros: Approval route; bank remits to own account abroad
cons: Needs SAFE approval + inheritance/property/tax docs; no cash withdrawal
steps_summary: Inheritance/property/tax docs -> SAFE approval -> own-name overseas account

name: Emigrant property transfer
who: Person who moved from mainland to live abroad (former hukou)
pros: No annual quota; bank may remit once or in instalments within approval
cons: Needs hukou cancellation/settlement/property/tax docs + SAFE approval

name: Annual convenience quota - $50k/yr ID-only
who: Green-card holders (T05) / domestic individuals (T07) within quota
pros: ID-only up to USD 50k/yr; no source docs within quota
cons: US passport alone insufficient; above quota needs documents; $400k = 8 years; splitting via others prohibited
steps_summary: ID -> buy/remit up to USD 50k/yr -> repeat next year(s)

name: Cross-border RMB offshore, convert there
who: Individual whose bank offers cross-border RMB settlement
cons: Both price components blank in this session; needs bank offer + offshore account
steps_summary: Bank cross-border RMB -> own offshore account -> convert there

name: Dividend - 20% statutory scenario
cons: Tax dwarfs wire cost ($80,000 on $400k gross); needs profit resolution + tax filing
steps_summary: Profit resolution + tax filing -> 20% -> remit net

name: Dividend - 10% treaty-cap scenario
who: Beneficial-owner resident eligible for treaty relief
pros: Halves Chinese dividend tax vs 20% (saves $40,000 on $400k)
cons: Eligibility (residence/beneficial ownership) must be proved; not automatic
steps_summary: As M09 + treaty eligibility evidence -> 10% cap -> remit net

name: Overseas ATM withdrawals
who: Holder of mainland UnionPay card needing cash abroad
cons: CNY 10k/day, 100k/yr caps; $400k needs 268 withdrawals / 27 years; fees high ($4,480.93 on $400k)
steps_summary: Card -> withdraw abroad within caps -> pay per-withdrawal fee

name: Carry lawfully purchased FX banknotes
pros: No wire fee; spread only ($20.94 on $10k)
cons: USD 5k/trip (10k with bank permit); $400k = 80 trips; declare >USD 10k entering US; theft/loss risk
steps_summary: Buy FX -> carry within limits -> declare >USD 10k to CBP

name: Wise from-CNY (own account only)
who: Non-mainland person who worked in China with recent tax record
pros: Bank-app funding; limit = salary less tax; own-account only
cons: Fee/FX blank (in-app only); max CNY 300k/transfer; eligibility strict
steps_summary: Verify ID/tax records -> fund from bank app -> own account

name: Western Union China (cash pickup)
pros: Cash pickup in minutes at 525k+ locations
cons: Bank delivery unavailable; fee/FX blank; partner-bank restrictions possible
steps_summary: Partner bank -> verify -> pay quoted fee -> cash pickup

name: Gift / undocumented origin - NO verified route
cons: No verified lawful route in this research; do not invent purpose or use others' quota
steps_summary: Obtain bank's written determination; do not proceed without it
